brief.summary: US equity markets are rallying today, driven by a pullback in Treasury yields following dovish remarks from Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller. Waller indicated he would support holding rates steady at the September meeting if inflation data continues to show progress, easing fears of an imminent hike. This has sparked a broad advance across major indices like SPY, QQQ, and IWM, while gold (GLD) is also catching a bid on the softer rate outlook. Investors are largely looking past rising oil prices and overnight geopolitical tensions in the Middle East to focus on the favorable monetary policy signals.
